title: FDR's 1937 Desert Game Range guarded by anti-aircraft guns 'to protect bighorn sheep'
summary: Charles Hall tells of FDR's 1937 Desert Game Range guarded by anti-aircraft guns 'to protect bighorn sheep', about 1935-1937, 1970 at Desert Game Range / Sheep Peak, Nevada, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Desert Game Range / Sheep Peak, Nevada

tellings.quote: Now, the Desert Game Range was set up in the time of Franklin D. Roosevelt.

plain: Charles Hall, a man who says he spent years in the Nevada desert alongside tall white beings near Area 51, the secret US air base, tells of a wildlife refuge called the Desert Game Range. He says it was set up under President Franklin D. Roosevelt in the 1930s and was guarded with anti-aircraft guns, supposedly to protect bighorn sheep. To Hall, that cover story suggests the land was really being protected for something far stranger.
